description: Returns the calling key, the exact balance of the ledger behind it (balanceMicro: integer micro-credits, 1 credit = $1.00 = 1,000,000), what is left in each daily quota bucket, and the environment. Free, and consumes no quota. (GET https://app.deepvalues.ai/api/v1/keys/me — free; needs a connected account or a dv_sk_ key)
